form_data.treatment_explanation: Thank you for choosing the Jessner Peel treatment. This medium-depth chemical peel uses a blend of lactic acid, salicylic acid, and resorcinol to exfoliate and rejuvenate the skin, improving texture, reducing pigmentation, and helping with acne.
form_data.introduction: Correct aftercare is essential to achieve the best results, avoid complications, and support healthy skin healing.

sections.title: Mild Redness & Warmth
sections.content: You may notice redness, tightness, and a sensation of warmth — similar to mild sunburn — immediately after treatment. This usually subsides within 24–48 hours.

sections.title: Sensitivity
sections.content: Your skin will be more sensitive to touch and temperature. Avoid touching, scratching, or rubbing the treated area.

sections.title: No Washing for the First 12 Hours
sections.content: Keep the skin dry for the first 12 hours to allow the peel to work effectively.

sections.title: Gentle Cleansing
sections.content: After 12 hours, cleanse the skin gently using a mild, fragrance-free cleanser. Do not scrub, rub, or use exfoliating brushes.

sections.title: Moisturising
sections.content: Keep your skin hydrated with a gentle, fragrance-free moisturiser. Apply as often as needed to reduce dryness, tightness, and flaking.

sections.title: Peeling & Flaking
sections.content: Peeling will usually start 2–4 days after the peel and may last up to 7 days. Do not pick, peel, or scratch off flaking skin, as this can cause scarring or uneven pigmentation.

sections.title: Avoid Sun Exposure
sections.content: Your skin is highly sensitive to sunlight after a Jessner Peel. Avoid direct sun for at least 2 weeks. Always apply a broad-spectrum sunscreen SPF 30 or higher when outdoors.

sections.title: Avoid Makeup for 24 Hours
sections.content: Wait at least 24 hours before applying makeup to the treated area. Use mineral or non-comedogenic products.

sections.title: Avoid Harsh Products
sections.content: Do not use products containing retinol, acids (AHA/BHA), benzoyl peroxide, or alcohol for at least 2–4 weeks.

sections.title: Continue Sun Protection
sections.content: Daily SPF use is essential to prevent pigmentation changes and maintain results.

sections.title: Avoid Heat Exposure
sections.content: Avoid hot baths, saunas, and steam rooms for 1 week, as heat can increase redness and irritation.

common_side_effects.title: Common Side Effects
items: Redness: Mild to moderate redness for several days is normal.
Tightness & Dryness: Common as the skin renews.
Peeling: This is part of the treatment process.
Temporary Pigment Changes: Rare, but more common in darker skin tones without strict sun protection.

emergency_guidance.title: When to Contact Us
emergency_guidance.content: Seek medical advice immediately if you experience:
items: Signs of infection (yellow crusting, pus, spreading redness).
Persistent dark or light patches after peeling.

long_term_care.title: Long-Term Care
items: Maintain a gentle skincare routine with regular hydration and sun protection.
Avoid repeated harsh treatments until your skin is fully healed.
Follow your practitioner's guidance for maintenance peels.
